args.body:
Hello, we have emailed invoice I-0013 (the most recent invoice on account C-003, 768.26 USD, status open) to daniela.garcia@acme.test.

We could not send invoice I-0704. It is not associated with account C-003, and we can only share invoices for an account after verifying the requester is authorized on that account. If your second account is under your control, please contact us from that account's registered email or verify ownership, and we will send it then.

If I-0013 was not the invoice you meant, let us know which one and we will send it.
